newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-RINDEL TOP SCORES WITH 109 VS GRIQUAS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RINDEL TOP SCORES WITH 109 VS GRIQUAS.

text.p: Rindel top-scored with a fluent 109 to guide Northern Transvaal
to a challenging 233 for five in their Standard Bank Cup
quarter-final replay against Griqualand West at Kimberley
Rindel struck eight fours and a six to reach his fifth
century in limited-overs cricket as Northerns challenged for a
place in the semi-finals of the competition against Western
The former South African international was eventually leg
before wicket to the left-arm seam of Adri Swanepoel, having hit
nine fours, a six and faced 132 deliveries in all.
Northerns got off to a solid start with a first-wicket
partnership of 98 between Rindel and the stylish Roy Pienaar
(47) after captain Mark Davis won the toss and chose to bat
But Griquas then pegged them back in mid-innings as
Swanepoel went on to take 3-43 and slow left-armer Brett
Dirkie de Vos hammered an unbeaten 30 from 22 balls with one
six to boost the Northerns' total in the final overs.
M.van Jaarsveld c and b Swanepoel 1
Did not bat: M.Davis, D.Smith, F.de Villiers, R.Bryson.
Griqualand West: M.Arthur, M.Gidley, P.Barnard, W.Dry,
